blocks.zh: 規劃階段
blocks.en: Planning Stage

blocks.zh: 本節內容 — Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 規劃階段 — 核心解說
blocks.en: Planning Stage: Key Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：規劃階段的本質
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Nature of the Planning Stage

blocks.zh: 規劃階段（Planning Stage）是整個技術移轉（TT）中正式知識傳遞的起點。它在地點選定、初始章程獲批准後才啟動，意味著此時「做不做」已決定，進入的是「怎麼做」的細部規劃。
blocks.en: The Planning Stage is the point at which formal knowledge transfer begins in a technology transfer (TT). It starts only after the site has been selected and the initial charter approved, which means the "whether" has already been decided and the work now turns to the detailed planning of the "how".

blocks.zh: TT 專案經理（TT PM）正式指派
blocks.en: The TT Project Manager (TT PM) is formally appointed

blocks.zh: 接收單位（RU）核心團隊完成組建
blocks.en: The Receiving Unit (RU) core team is fully assembled

blocks.zh: 詳細風險評估取代高層次評估
blocks.en: Detailed risk assessments replace high-level assessments

blocks.zh: 專案計畫升級為具體、可執行版本
blocks.en: The project plan is upgraded to a specific, executable version

blocks.zh: 比喻：從「選地建廠」到「施工藍圖」
blocks.en: Analogy: From "choosing a site" to "construction blueprints"

blocks.zh: 啟動階段（Initiation）如同選定建廠地點，規劃階段則是繪製詳細施工藍圖——每一根鋼筋、每條水電管線都要定位。少了這份藍圖，施工必然混亂且高成本。
blocks.en: The Initiation Stage is like choosing where to build the plant; the Planning Stage is drawing the detailed construction blueprints, where every rebar and every utility line is positioned. Without this blueprint, construction will be chaotic and costly.

blocks.zh: 關鍵輸出（Key Outputs）
blocks.en: Key Outputs

blocks.zh: 最終 TT 章程（Final TT Charter）
blocks.en: Final TT Charter

blocks.zh: SU / RU / MAH 三方 TT 協議
blocks.en: Three-party TT agreement among SU / RU / MAH

blocks.zh: 詳細專案計畫（含關鍵路徑）
blocks.en: Detailed project plan (including the critical path)

blocks.zh: Stage Gate 批准——向 Knowledge Transfer 推進
blocks.en: Stage Gate approval to advance to Knowledge Transfer

blocks.zh: 5.2.1 商務功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.1 Business Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：供應協議與資源計畫
blocks.en: Core Concept: Supply Agreement and Resource Planning

blocks.zh: 商務功能在規劃階段的核心任務有二：
blocks.en: The business function has two core tasks in the Planning Stage:

blocks.zh: 執行供應協議（Master Service Agreement, MSA）— 確保協議邊界與 TT 章程一致
blocks.en: Execute the supply agreement (Master Service Agreement, MSA), ensuring the agreement boundaries are consistent with the TT charter

blocks.zh: 批准資源與資本計畫— 與指導委員會共同監督
blocks.en: Approve the resource and capital plans, with oversight shared with the steering committee

blocks.zh: 許多 RU 要求供應協議承諾固定批次數，涵蓋初始確認批次及年度商業生產，以利資源規劃。
blocks.en: Many RUs ask the supply agreement to commit to a fixed number of batches, covering the initial confirmation batches and annual commercial production, to support resource planning.

blocks.zh: 比喻：婚前財產協議
blocks.en: Analogy: The prenuptial agreement

blocks.zh: 供應協議就像婚前財產協議——在合作開始前把「誰負責什麼、做多少批、給多少錢」全部寫清楚，避免日後合作爭議。TT PM 必須確認協議內容與 TT 章程一致，否則「說一套、做另一套」的矛盾將在執行時爆發。
blocks.en: A supply agreement is like a prenuptial agreement: before the partnership begins, it spells out who is responsible for what, how many batches will be made and how much will be paid, to avoid later disputes. The TT PM must confirm that the agreement is consistent with the TT charter; otherwise the contradiction of "saying one thing and doing another" will surface during execution.

blocks.zh: 資源計畫四要素
blocks.en: The Four Elements of a Resource Plan

blocks.zh:
資源計畫 =
  ① 人員配置（人數 + 班次安排）
+ ② 設備資格（自動化 vs. 手動作業比例）
+ ③ 所需專業類型（製程、分析、法規、品保⋯）
+ ④ 技術複雜度（含風險緩解需求）
blocks.en:
Resource plan =
  (1) Staffing (headcount + shift arrangements)
+ (2) Equipment qualification (ratio of automated vs. manual operations)
+ (3) Types of expertise required (process, analytical, regulatory, QA...)
+ (4) Technical complexity (including risk mitigation needs)

blocks.zh: 同時須涵蓋 TT 期間需求 AND 長期商業生產需求，兩者不可偏廢。
blocks.en: The plan must cover both TT-period needs AND long-term commercial production needs; neither should be neglected.

blocks.zh: 重點提示：驗證批次可否銷售？
blocks.en: Key Point: Can validation batches be sold?

blocks.zh: 商務功能必須向法規策略提供「驗證批次（validation batches）是否可商業銷售」的資訊。在某些市場，驗證批次可作商業出貨，大幅降低成本；但需法規批准時間配合，必須提前規劃。
blocks.en: The business function must give regulatory strategy information on whether validation batches can be sold commercially. In some markets validation batches can be shipped commercially, which greatly reduces cost; however, this depends on the timing of regulatory approval and must be planned in advance.

blocks.zh: 5.2.2 TT 專案經理 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.2 TT Project Manager: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：TT PM 的角色轉換
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Changing Role of the TT PM

blocks.zh: TT PM 在規劃階段從「協調者」升格為「主導者」。他/她必須具備：
blocks.en: In the Planning Stage the TT PM moves from "coordinator" to "leader". The TT PM must have:

blocks.zh: 跨功能領域的知識（製程、分析、法規、品保⋯）
blocks.en: Cross-functional knowledge (process, analytical, regulatory, QA...)

blocks.zh: 跨組織層級的溝通能力
blocks.en: The ability to communicate across organizational levels

blocks.zh: 談判、決策、激勵等領導技能
blocks.en: Leadership skills such as negotiation, decision-making and motivation

blocks.zh: 比喻：交響樂團指揮
blocks.en: Analogy: The symphony conductor

blocks.zh: TT PM 如同交響樂團指揮——不必親自演奏每件樂器，但必須知道每個樂手何時進場、如何配合，並在混亂中維持節奏。RACI 矩陣就是那份樂譜，確保每個人清楚自己的音符。
blocks.en: The TT PM is like a symphony conductor: there is no need to play every instrument personally, but the conductor must know when each player comes in and how they fit together, and keep the tempo when things get chaotic. The RACI matrix is the score that makes sure everyone knows their own notes.

blocks.zh: RACI 矩陣的實用價值
blocks.en: The Practical Value of the RACI Matrix

blocks.zh: Responsible（執行）、Accountable（當責）、Consulted（諮詢）、Informed（知會）——在 SU、RU、MAH 三方同時涉及時，若無 RACI，責任重疊與空白幾乎無可避免。
blocks.en: Responsible, Accountable, Consulted, Informed: when SU, RU and MAH are all involved, overlapping and missing responsibilities are almost unavoidable without a RACI.

blocks.zh: 專案計畫七大覆蓋項目
blocks.en: The Seven Items the Project Plan Must Cover

blocks.zh:
專案計畫必須涵蓋：
① 資本採購、安裝、資格認定時程
② 物料與耗材採購及放行
③ 製程開發 / 展示
④ 分析方法驗證、移轉或確認
⑤ 操作就緒需求
⑥ 廠規模製程驗證（PV）
⑦ 關鍵里程碑與關鍵路徑活動
blocks.en:
The project plan must cover:
(1) Capital procurement, installation and qualification timelines
(2) Procurement and release of materials and consumables
(3) Process development / demonstration
(4) Analytical method validation, transfer or verification
(5) Operational readiness requirements
(6) Full-scale process validation (PV)
(7) Key milestones and critical path activities

blocks.zh: 思考練習：您廠的 Kick-Off 會議夠完整嗎？
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: Is your site's Kick-Off meeting complete enough?

blocks.zh: PDA TR65 明確要求 TT PM 在規劃階段末召開 Kick-Off 會議，邀集 SU、RU 雙方跨功能成員及專案贊助人。
blocks.en: PDA TR65 explicitly calls for the TT PM to hold a Kick-Off meeting at the end of the Planning Stage, bringing together cross-functional members from both SU and RU as well as the project sponsor.

blocks.zh: 請評估：您上一次或下一次技術移轉的 Kick-Off 會議，是否確實涵蓋 SU 代表？是否有正式溝通計畫（含升級機制）？
blocks.en: Please assess: Did your last Kick-Off meeting, or will your next one, genuinely include SU representatives? Is there a formal communication plan (including an escalation mechanism)?

blocks.zh: 5.2.3 製程功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.3 Process Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：商業製程的規格化
blocks.en: Core Concept: Specifying the Commercial Process

blocks.zh: 製程功能在此階段將 SU 的製程知識「翻譯」成 RU 可執行的規格：
blocks.en: At this stage the process function "translates" the SU's process knowledge into specifications the RU can execute:

blocks.zh: 批量（batch scale）確定
blocks.en: Determine the batch scale

blocks.zh: 單元操作（unit operations）盤點
blocks.en: Inventory the unit operations

blocks.zh: 週期時間（cycle time）估算
blocks.en: Estimate the cycle time

blocks.zh: 物料處理需求 → 初始物料清單（Bill of Materials）
blocks.en: Material handling requirements → initial Bill of Materials

blocks.zh: 比喻：食譜的「在地化」改版
blocks.en: Analogy: "Localizing" a recipe

blocks.zh: 將法式料理食譜改成台灣廚房可以執行的版本——食材換了、爐具不同、份量放大——比較計畫（comparability plan）就是確保「改版後的菜餚口感與原版一致」的驗收標準。
blocks.en: It is like adapting a French recipe for a Taiwanese kitchen: the ingredients change, the stove is different and the quantities are scaled up. The comparability plan is the acceptance standard that ensures the adapted dish tastes the same as the original.

blocks.zh: 重點：變更控制必須現在啟動
blocks.en: Key Point: Change control must start now

blocks.zh: 製程功能在規劃階段就要在變更管理系統中正式發出「TT 變更申請」，並確保 SU 與 RU 的變更控制流程相互對齊。延遲啟動變更控制常是後期稽核缺失的根源。
blocks.en: In the Planning Stage the process function should formally raise a "TT change request" in the change management system and make sure the SU and RU change control processes are aligned with each other. Delaying the start of change control is often the root of later audit findings.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：新產品 vs. 既有產品
blocks.en: Practical Application: New product vs. existing product

blocks.zh: 若 TT 涉及的是新產品或新技術，製程必須設計到能在 RU 穩定重現，且持續符合 QTPP 要求。這與移轉既有成熟產品有本質差異——設計自由度更大，但不確定性也更高，風險評估必須更深入。
blocks.en: If the TT involves a new product or new technology, the process must be designed so that it can be reproduced reliably at the RU and continue to meet the QTPP. This is fundamentally different from transferring an established, mature product: there is greater design freedom but also greater uncertainty, so the risk assessment must be more thorough.

blocks.zh: 5.2.4 分析功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.4 Analytical Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：分析測試地點的決策
blocks.en: Core Concept: Deciding Where Analytical Testing Is Performed

blocks.zh: 分析功能必須決定每一項測試方法在哪裡執行：
blocks.en: The analytical function must decide where each test method will be performed:

blocks.zh: SU 實驗室（已有資格認定）
blocks.en: SU laboratory (already qualified)

blocks.zh: RU 實驗室（需方法移轉）
blocks.en: RU laboratory (method transfer required)

blocks.zh: MAH 中央實驗室
blocks.en: MAH central laboratory

blocks.zh: 外部合約實驗室
blocks.en: External contract laboratory

blocks.zh: 此決策直接影響資本投入與時程安排。
blocks.en: This decision directly affects capital investment and scheduling.

blocks.zh: 比喻：血液檢驗的分流
blocks.en: Analogy: Triage of blood tests

blocks.zh: 就像醫院決定哪些血液項目自行檢驗、哪些外送中心實驗室——常規項目留院做，罕見或高精度項目外包。分析功能的測試地點決策邏輯相同：依設備能力、成本、時效三角平衡。
blocks.en: It is like a hospital deciding which blood tests to run in-house and which to send to a central laboratory: routine tests stay in the hospital, while rare or high-precision tests are outsourced. The analytical function applies the same logic to testing locations, balancing three factors: equipment capability, cost and turnaround time.

blocks.zh: 重點：參考標準品與試劑的前置採購
blocks.en: Key Point: Procure reference standards and reagents early

blocks.zh: 分析方法驗證、移轉所需的參考標準品（reference standards）及關鍵試劑（critical analytical reagents）必須在規劃階段就估算用量並預排採購。這類物質往往有長交期或特殊儲存需求，拖到執行階段才處理會成為關鍵路徑瓶頸。
blocks.en: The reference standards and critical analytical reagents needed for method validation and transfer must have their quantities estimated and their purchases scheduled in the Planning Stage. These materials often have long lead times or special storage requirements, and leaving them until the execution stage will make them a critical path bottleneck.

blocks.zh: 取樣計畫六要素
blocks.en: The Six Elements of a Sampling Plan

blocks.zh:
取樣計畫 =
① 取樣數量（number of samples）
② 每次取樣量（amount per sample）
③ 執行測試項目（tests performed）
④ 取樣位置（sample location）
⑤ 是否僅在製程驗證期間評估
⑥ 對驗證批次產率的衝擊評估
blocks.en:
Sampling plan =
(1) Number of samples
(2) Amount per sample
(3) Tests performed
(4) Sample location
(5) Whether evaluated only during process validation
(6) Assessment of the impact on validation batch yield

blocks.zh: 5.2.5 工程功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.5 Engineering Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CAR 與長交期設備
blocks.en: Core Concept: The CAR and Long-Lead Equipment

blocks.zh: 工程功能的核心任務是將製程需求轉換成資本採購申請（CAR）。關鍵挑戰：
blocks.en: The core task of the engineering function is to convert process requirements into a capital appropriation request (CAR). The key challenges are:

blocks.zh: 長交期設備（long-lead equipment）往往需要在 URS / CAR 完成前就先下訂單
blocks.en: Long-lead equipment often has to be ordered before the URS / CAR is complete

blocks.zh: 設備安裝、資格認定（IQ/OQ/PQ）必須與整體專案時程對齊
blocks.en: Equipment installation and qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ) must be aligned with the overall project timeline

blocks.zh: 廠房改建與實驗室改造均需納入變更控制
blocks.en: Facility modifications and laboratory renovations must both be brought under change control

blocks.zh: 比喻：裝潢前先訂義大利進口磁磚
blocks.en: Analogy: Ordering Italian imported tiles before the renovation

blocks.zh: 裝潢設計圖還沒畫完，但義大利磁磚交期18週——先訂。工程功能面對的是同樣邏輯：凍乾機、隔離器、自動化灌裝設備的交期常達12-18個月，等 URS 完成再訂，移轉時程必然推遲。
blocks.en: The renovation drawings are not finished, but the Italian tiles have an 18-week lead time, so you order first. The engineering function faces the same logic: lead times for freeze dryers, isolators and automated filling equipment often reach 12-18 months, and waiting for the URS to be finished before ordering will inevitably delay the transfer timeline.

blocks.zh: CDMO / CMO 特殊考量
blocks.en: Special Considerations for a CDMO / CMO

blocks.zh: 若 RU 為外部 CDMO/CMO，工程功能的執行責任可能移交至合約廠，但 TT Team 必須保持強力監督（strong oversight）。TT PM 需特別協調設備安裝、資格認定與培訓的時程，確保與整體計畫同步。
blocks.en: If the RU is an external CDMO/CMO, responsibility for executing engineering tasks may be handed to the contract site, but the TT Team must maintain strong oversight. The TT PM needs to coordinate the timelines for equipment installation, qualification and training so that they stay in step with the overall plan.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：您的 TT 有哪些長交期設備？
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: Which long-lead equipment does your TT involve?

blocks.zh: 在您目前或即將進行的技術移轉中，列出三個可能成為時程瓶頸的長交期設備或基礎設施項目，並估算其交期。這些項目是否已納入 CAR 或提前採購規劃？
blocks.en: For a technology transfer you are running now or about to run, list three long-lead equipment or infrastructure items that could become schedule bottlenecks and estimate their lead times. Have these items been included in the CAR or in advance procurement planning?

blocks.zh: 5.2.6 製造功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.6 Manufacturing Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：操作就緒（Operational Readiness）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Operational Readiness

blocks.zh: 製造功能的核心目標是確保 RU 在技術層面就緒之外，操作層面也同步就緒：
blocks.en: The core objective of the manufacturing function is to make sure that, in addition to being technically ready, the RU is also ready operationally:

blocks.zh: 員工能力 vs. 新製程/新設備要求的差距分析
blocks.en: Gap analysis of staff capabilities against new process / new equipment requirements

blocks.zh: 環境、健康、安全（EHS）法規許可
blocks.en: Environmental, health and safety (EHS) regulatory permits

blocks.zh: 操作培訓計畫（新製程 + 改建廠房）
blocks.en: Operator training plan (new process + modified facility)

blocks.zh: URS / CAR 需求定義（與工程、製程協作）
blocks.en: URS / CAR requirement definition (in collaboration with engineering and process)

blocks.zh: 比喻：新機型上線前的機師訓練
blocks.en: Analogy: Pilot training before a new aircraft type enters service

blocks.zh: 航空公司引進新機型時，設備本身再好，沒有受訓合格的機師就無法起飛。製造功能的任務就是確保「人員就緒」與「設備就緒」同步——在執行階段正式開始前完成差距訓練。
blocks.en: When an airline introduces a new aircraft type, however good the aircraft is, it cannot fly without trained and qualified pilots. The task of the manufacturing function is to keep "people readiness" and "equipment readiness" in step by completing gap training before the execution stage formally begins.

blocks.zh: EHS 評估不可拖延
blocks.en: EHS Assessment Must Not Be Delayed

blocks.zh: EHS 評估範圍涵蓋：個人防護設備（PPE）、產品生物安全、無菌操作規範、危險物質處理、排放廢氣及廢液處理。許可證（permits）申請往往需要數月時間，若規劃階段未啟動，將成為執行階段的阻礙。
blocks.en: The EHS assessment covers personal protective equipment (PPE), product biosafety, aseptic operating practices, handling of hazardous substances, and treatment of exhaust air and liquid waste. Permit applications often take several months; if they are not started in the Planning Stage, they will become an obstacle in the execution stage.

blocks.zh: 5.2.7 法規功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.7 Regulatory Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：法規策略從文件變成行動計畫
blocks.en: Core Concept: Turning Regulatory Strategy from a Document into an Action Plan

blocks.zh: 啟動階段的法規策略是方向性文件；進入規劃階段，法規功能必須將其深化為：
blocks.en: The regulatory strategy from the Initiation Stage is a directional document; on entering the Planning Stage, the regulatory function must develop it into:

blocks.zh: 含草稿、審查、批准時程的詳細提交追蹤表
blocks.en: A detailed submission tracker with draft, review and approval timelines

blocks.zh: MAH 與 RU 雙方的風險耐受度對齊
blocks.en: Alignment of the risk tolerance of both the MAH and the RU

blocks.zh: 各職能詳細風險評估的需求輸入
blocks.en: Input on requirements for each function's detailed risk assessment

blocks.zh: 比喻：上市路線圖的精細化
blocks.en: Analogy: Refining the route map to market

blocks.zh: 啟動階段畫的是「大陸地圖」，規劃階段要畫「縣市街道圖」——知道每一條路的走法、哪些路段可能塞車（監管機構審查），並決定要走哪條最短路線（加速申請的機會點）。
blocks.en: The Initiation Stage draws a "continental map"; the Planning Stage draws a "city street map", showing how to travel each road, which sections may be congested (regulatory authority review) and which shortest route to take (opportunities to expedite the filing).

blocks.zh: 法規風險五大來源
blocks.en: Five Sources of Regulatory Risk

blocks.zh: 穩定性策略（stability strategy）
blocks.en: Stability strategy

blocks.zh: 分析方法移轉（analytical method transfers）
blocks.en: Analytical method transfers

blocks.zh: 驗證批次數量與時程
blocks.en: Number and timing of validation batches

blocks.zh: 製程變更或改進
blocks.en: Process changes or improvements

blocks.zh: RU 可從 SU 借用的數據與活動範圍
blocks.en: The scope of data and activities the RU can leverage from the SU

blocks.zh: 實務要點：讓 RU 了解 CQA / CPP
blocks.en: Practical Point: Make the RU understand the CQAs / CPPs

blocks.zh: 法規功能必須確保提交文件中的 CQA（關鍵品質屬性）與 CPP（關鍵製程參數）資訊傳遞給 RU。RU 了解這些關鍵挑戰，才能確認自身輸入條件能否滿足要求。這是避免執行階段「做了才發現做不到」的關鍵防線。
blocks.en: The regulatory function must make sure the information on CQAs (critical quality attributes) and CPPs (critical process parameters) in the submission is passed to the RU. Only when the RU understands these key challenges can it confirm whether its own input conditions can meet the requirements. This is the key safeguard against the "discovering during execution that it cannot be done" problem.

blocks.zh: 5.2.8 品保功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.8 Quality Assurance Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：品質協議與 QMS 對齊
blocks.en: Core Concept: Quality Agreements and QMS Alignment

blocks.zh: 品保功能在規劃階段的三大任務：
blocks.en: The quality assurance function has three main tasks in the Planning Stage:

blocks.zh: 品質協議：MAH↔RU、RU/MAH↔外部實驗室，須同步執行
blocks.en: Quality agreements: MAH-RU and RU/MAH-external laboratories, which must be put in place in parallel

blocks.zh: RU 稽核：找出並在執行前消弭合規缺口
blocks.en: RU audit: identify compliance gaps and close them before execution

blocks.zh: QMS 對齊：即使 SU 與 RU 同屬內部，不同地區對全球 QMS 的解讀可能不同
blocks.en: QMS alignment: even when the SU and RU are both internal, different regions may interpret the global QMS differently

blocks.zh: 比喻：婚前健康檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: The premarital health check

blocks.zh: 在正式合作（執行階段）開始前，MAH 對 RU 進行品質稽核，就像婚前健康檢查——提前發現問題，有時間處理，而不是在蜜月旅行（生產驗證）時才發現雙方體質不合。
blocks.en: Before the formal partnership (the execution stage) begins, the MAH audits the RU's quality systems, like a premarital health check: problems are found early, with time to deal with them, rather than being discovered on the honeymoon (production validation) when the two sides turn out to be incompatible.

blocks.zh: 重點：穩定性計畫是法規時程的骨架
blocks.en: Key Point: The stability plan is the backbone of the regulatory timeline

blocks.zh: 品保功能協助制定的穩定性計畫（stability plan）直接影響法規申請時程——加速穩定性研究可縮短申請等待期，但必須確保所有現有承諾條件均能滿足。穩定性計畫是 Quality、Process、Analytical、Regulatory 四功能協作的輸出。
blocks.en: The stability plan that QA helps to develop directly affects the regulatory filing timeline: accelerating the stability studies can shorten the wait before filing, but it must be ensured that all existing commitments can still be met. The stability plan is an output of collaboration among the Quality, Process, Analytical and Regulatory functions.

blocks.zh: 重點：內部移轉也需 QMS 對齊
blocks.en: Key Point: Internal transfers also need QMS alignment

blocks.zh: 許多公司誤以為「同公司內部廠間移轉」不需要正式的 QMS 對齊。PDA TR65 明確指出：即使 SU 與 RU 同屬內部，區域間對全球 QMS 的解讀差異真實存在，必須正式協商並記錄對齊結果。
blocks.en: Many companies mistakenly believe that a transfer between sites within the same company does not need formal QMS alignment. PDA TR65 states clearly that even when the SU and RU are both internal, differences between regions in interpreting the global QMS are real, and alignment must be formally negotiated and the result documented.

blocks.zh: 5.2.9 採購 / 供應鏈功能 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.9 Purchasing / Supply Chain Function: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：生產計畫的四維度評估
blocks.en: Core Concept: Four Dimensions of Production Planning

blocks.zh: 供應鏈功能評估 TT 所需時間，必須納入四個維度：
blocks.en: When the supply chain function assesses the time needed for the TT, it must include four dimensions:

blocks.zh: 工程安裝與資格認定時間
blocks.en: Engineering installation and qualification time

blocks.zh: 工程批次數量
blocks.en: Number of engineering batches

blocks.zh: 確認批次數量
blocks.en: Number of confirmation batches

blocks.zh: 穩定性研究及法規批准時間
blocks.en: Stability study and regulatory approval time

blocks.zh: 計畫性停機（預防保養、清潔）也必須納入，不可忽略。
blocks.en: Planned shutdowns (preventive maintenance, cleaning) must also be included and must not be overlooked.

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳開幕前的食材備料
blocks.en: Analogy: Sourcing ingredients before a restaurant opens

blocks.zh: 新餐廳開幕前，廚師要先確認：哪些食材只有一家供應商（sole-source）？哪些需要提前3個月訂購（long-lead）？一旦開幕後才發現關鍵食材斷貨，代價極高。供應鏈功能在規劃階段做的正是這件事——為技術移轉備好「食材」。
blocks.en: Before a new restaurant opens, the chef must first confirm which ingredients have only one supplier (sole-source) and which must be ordered 3 months ahead (long-lead). Discovering after opening that a key ingredient is out of stock is very costly. This is exactly what the supply chain function does in the Planning Stage: it gets the "ingredients" ready for the technology transfer.

blocks.zh: 供應鏈地圖：預防未來麻煩的地雷圖
blocks.en: The Supply Chain Map: A Minefield Map to Prevent Future Trouble

blocks.zh: 規劃階段的關鍵輸出之一是詳細的供應鏈地圖，顯示：
blocks.en: One of the key outputs of the Planning Stage is a detailed supply chain map showing:

blocks.zh: 進出口考量（import/export）
blocks.en: Import/export considerations

blocks.zh: 配銷商與關鍵組件製造商
blocks.en: Distributors and critical component manufacturers

blocks.zh: 二次供應來源（second sources）機會
blocks.en: Opportunities for second sources

blocks.zh: 這張地圖是未來供應鏈風險識別和故障排除的基礎工具。
blocks.en: This map is the basic tool for future supply chain risk identification and troubleshooting.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：Sole-Source 物料的雙重風險
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Double Risk of Sole-Source Materials

blocks.zh:
單一來源（sole-sourced）物料面臨兩重風險：
① 供應中斷風險（廠商停產、品質問題）
② 法規風險（更換供應商需重新驗證、申請變更）
在規劃階段盡早識別這類物料，並評估是否需要開發第二供應來源，是供應鏈韌性的核心工作。
blocks.en:
Sole-sourced materials face two kinds of risk:
(1) Supply interruption risk (supplier discontinues production, quality problems)
(2) Regulatory risk (changing supplier requires revalidation and a change filing)
Identifying such materials early in the Planning Stage and assessing whether a second source needs to be developed is a core part of supply chain resilience.

blocks.zh: 5.2.10 最佳實踐 — 解說
blocks.en: 5.2.10 Best Practices: Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：五大最佳實踐主題
blocks.en: Core Concept: Five Best Practice Themes

blocks.zh: 本節彙整規劃階段的最佳實踐，涵蓋：kickoff 品質、既有條件理解、新廠導入先決條件、風險評估更新、以及專案監督與團隊投入。
blocks.en: This section brings together the best practices for the Planning Stage, covering: kickoff quality, understanding existing conditions, prerequisites for introducing a new facility, updating the risk assessment, and project oversight and team commitment.

blocks.zh: 比喻：工地的安全規範手冊
blocks.en: Analogy: The construction site safety manual

blocks.zh: 最佳實踐清單如同工地安全規範——不是每個項目都會出問題，但每一條規範背後都有血淚教訓。跳過任何一項，風險不是零，而是未知。
blocks.en: The best practice list is like a construction site safety manual: not every item will go wrong, but behind every rule is a hard lesson. Skipping any item does not make the risk zero; it makes it unknown.

blocks.zh: 思考練習：您的 Kickoff 是「儀式」還是「對齊」？
blocks.en: Reflection Exercise: Is your Kickoff a "ceremony" or an "alignment"?

blocks.zh: PDA 強調 kickoff 應面對面進行（若不能，預留1-2天討論時間），並建立文件共享平台。回顧您曾參與的 TT kickoff：它是打卡儀式，還是真正對齊計畫與里程碑的工作會議？差距在哪裡？
blocks.en: PDA stresses that the kickoff should be held face to face (if that is not possible, allow 1-2 days for discussion) and that a document-sharing platform should be set up. Look back at a TT kickoff you took part in: was it a box-ticking ceremony, or a working meeting that genuinely aligned the plan and milestones? Where was the gap?

blocks.zh: Section 5.2 Summary — 規劃階段總結
blocks.en: Section 5.2 Summary: Planning Stage Summary

blocks.zh: 核心要點（繁體中文）
blocks.en: Key Points (Commentary)

blocks.zh: 規劃階段始於地點選定後，終於 Stage Gate 批准，方可進入知識移轉階段
blocks.en: The Planning Stage begins after site selection and ends with Stage Gate approval, after which the project may proceed to the knowledge transfer stage

blocks.zh: TT PM 正式指派，主導跨職能團隊組建、RACI 制定與專案計畫開發
blocks.en: The TT PM is formally appointed and leads the formation of the cross-functional team, development of the RACI and development of the project plan

blocks.zh: 九大功能各有具體交付物，涵蓋供應協議（商務）到供應鏈地圖（採購）
blocks.en: Each of the nine functions has specific deliverables, ranging from the supply agreement (business) to the supply chain map (purchasing)

blocks.zh: 風險評估深化，驅動資源、資本與時程決策
blocks.en: Risk assessments are deepened and drive decisions on resources, capital and timeline

blocks.zh: 關鍵協議：供應協議、TT 協議（SU/RU）、品質協議、外部實驗室協議
blocks.en: Key agreements: supply agreement, TT agreement (SU/RU), quality agreement, external laboratory agreements

blocks.zh: 長交期設備/物料必須在 URS/CAR 完成前提前下訂或規劃
blocks.en: Long-lead equipment/materials must be ordered or planned ahead, before the URS/CAR is complete

blocks.zh: Kick-off 會議正式啟動跨職能 TT 團隊，對齊各方
blocks.en: The Kick-off meeting formally launches the cross-functional TT team and aligns all parties

blocks.zh: 一句話核心：規劃階段的本質是將啟動階段的高層次方向，轉換為九大功能各自承擔的具體承諾與可執行計畫——在任何實體工作開始之前，確保所有人知道「做什麼、誰來做、何時完成、如何衡量成功」。
blocks.en: The core in one sentence: the essence of the Planning Stage is to convert the high-level direction set in the Initiation Stage into the specific commitments and executable plans each of the nine functions will carry, so that before any physical work begins everyone knows "what to do, who will do it, when it will be completed and how success will be measured".
